ModuleDescription: Passes the eye tracking on to VR Gaze Mirror, so its gaze ring follows your eyes in SteamVR games. Makes no tracking data of its own; keep your real eye-tracking module. Loads last by design.
UsageInstructions: Install VR Gaze Mirror, then add this zip in VRCFT under Module Registry > Install from file (or Install module .zip). Restart VRCFT. The Mirror page of the VR Gaze Mirror app shows 'VRCFT module: feeding' once it works.
